title: Fluency: Ya-Sin 41 to 60: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 34 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Fluency rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 34. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ (٤٨) مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ (٤٩)

panels.title: Pace check
points: Breathe at ayah ends and signs

questions.q: Chain recitation of 36:41 to 60, one ayah per pupil.
Rota: today's group recites 36:41 to 60. Everyone else: 3-3-link the joins and log them.
Extend: time yourself reciting 36:49 to 60 at a steady pace and note it in the log.

options: very slow with long pauses everywhere
questions.a: A) steady, clear and correct. Tarteel is measured.

questions.q: Recite Ya-Sin 36:59 in your head. How does the next ayah begin?
Think again: What is the difference between reciting fast and reciting fluently?
questions.a: Fluency is steady and clear, with correct tajweed and stops; speed alone loses letters and meaning.
